g.text: NEED-TO-KNOW
open only YOUR
patients' charts!
MINIMUM
share the least
that helps!
ACT 843
Data Protection
Act 2012, Ghana!
ASK CONSENT
"may I tell your
sister the result?"
BREAK ONLY FOR
harm · outbreak ·
court — document!
5 LOCKS: need-to-know access + minimum sharing + consent habit + legal exceptions only
+ documented reasoning. Curiosity is NEVER need-to-know — "I wanted to see" fails every panel.
ACT 843 (examinable!): Ghana's Data Protection Act 2012 — personal data processed lawfully,
fairly, securely; patients have rights (access, correction, objection); Data Protection
Commission enforces; breaches bring sanctions. Health data = SENSITIVE — highest guard.
FAMILY DILEMMAS: "nurse, what is wrong with my husband?" — check CONSENT first ("has he said
I may share?"), share minimum, involve the patient ("let's tell her together"). Unconscious
emergency? Share what treatment needs, with whom it needs, document why. HIV results to a
partner? Counsel disclosure, offer mediated telling, know the policy — never ambush-call.
WARD LEAKS: corridor case-talk, lift gossip, screens facing visitors, printouts on desks,
photos of charts "for study" (NEVER!). Whisper rule: if a visitor could hear it, move it.
BREAK-GLASS: emergencies may override access blocks — allowed AND fully audited; justify in
the record the same shift. False "emergency" = snooping with extra steps.
MINORS + VULNERABLE: extra guard (abuse? STI? pregnancy?) — share with the care team +
safeguarding leads per policy, not with the waiting room. Document who knew and why.
LINKS: PRO-I M2/M3 confidentiality + consent · GER M3 elder dignity · NUT M6 CWC tact.
MANTRA: "their story, their consent, my lock — broken only to save."
